script.text: This can't be… I did everything I possibly could… But my best wasn't even close to being good enough!
Dennis, don't be rude. The first rule for a dueltainer is to acknowledge the crowd, especially one that's cheering for you.
You see, a true dueltainer doesn't focus on winning the duel. A true dueltainer focuses on winning the crowd and making them smile.
We can fix Duel Academy together. Bring smiles to the world instead of fear. As a true dueltainer.
After all the things I've done and the friends I've betrayed… There's no coming back from that.
Stay back! Listen, Kite. I know where Lulu is. And a girl who looks just like her named Rin.
Hey, that's who Yugo was looking for!
There are two huge towers at Duel Academy – you can't miss it. Rin's in the East Tower, Lulu's in the West.
If the Professor knew I told you that, he'd have me walking a tightrope with no net!
Many thanks for everything, Teach. I really hope you enjoyed the show.
And now it's time for my swan song, the grand finale, the final curtain – in other words – goodbye everyone!
